newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Avesta Sheffield rises as seen as good buy.
newsitem.headline: Avesta Sheffield rises as seen as good buy.

text.p: Shares in Swedish steel company Avesta Sheffield rose nearly four percent on Tuesday in reasonable turnover with analysts saying the share was seen as a good buy after underperforming other cyclical stocks.
At 1130 GMT Avesta Sheffield shares were 3.5 crowns higher at 91 crowns.
Analysts said the company had not been following the other economy sensitive stocks upwards and was seen as a good value.
Swedish brokerage Aros was the biggest buyer on Tuesday, taking up about 134,000 shares at an average price of 89.73 crowns.

"Avesta Sheffield has not kept up with the general upturn in other cyclical shares. If you compare it with SSAB you can see that SSAB has moved more against the index than Avesta has," one analyst told Reuters.
"We think therefore that there is some potential left in the share and that it is good value."
